note: Corpus samples for PLAN-low-stock-report.md Slice S7 (AC-70). Each row is a phrasing staff actually use for the low stock report, the cue the prompt teaches it by, and the parse keys that phrasing has to produce. Graded by sorento_crm_backend/tests/chatbot/test_parser_low_stock_words.py, which asserts (a) every cue is present verbatim in chatbot_parser_prompt.LOW_STOCK_ADDENDUM (so both the FULL and the SLIM published bodies carry it), and (b) every expected value is inside the declared vocabulary the code is written against (contracts.DOMAIN_HINTS / INTENT_HINTS). NOTHING HERE CALLS AN LLM: this file grades the CONTRACT between the prompt, the schema and the code, which is what a parser change can silently break. Whether the model actually obeys the vocabulary is a different gate - the console case at tests/chatbot/console_cases/2026-09-14-low-stock-report.yaml. Same shape and the same reasoning as parser_growth_r1_phrases.json beside it.
